sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: In the poem 'The Rainbow', what builds a road from earth to sky?
Identify the abstract noun in the following sentence: 'Her bravery saved the little child from the river.'
In 'Papa's Spectacles', why was Papa usually looking for his glasses everywhere?
options: A) He sold them in the market
B) He forgot where he kept them
C) A thief took them away
D) They were broken in half
questions.answer: B) He forgot where he kept them

questions.question_text: Choose the correct degree of comparison to fill in the blank: 'My school bag is ___ than yours.'
Fill in the blank with the correct article: 'She is ___ honest and hardworking girl.'
What is the primary lesson taught in the story 'The Wise Parrot'?
options: A) Greed always leads to a huge loss
B) Wisdom and quick thinking can save your life
C) Never trust a talking bird
D) You should always fly away from home
questions.answer: B) Wisdom and quick thinking can save your life

questions.question_text: Identify the tense of the given sentence: 'The children were playing in the garden happily.'
Which of the following is an exclamatory sentence?
options: A) Please close the front door.
B) What a beautiful dress this is!
C) Are you coming to the market?
D) I am reading a new book.
questions.answer: B) What a beautiful dress this is!

questions.question_text: In the story 'Gone with the Scooter', what was the main problem faced by the characters?
options: A) The scooter ran out of petrol completely
B) The scooter went missing from the house
C) The scooter had a flat tire on the road
D) The scooter turned into a small car
questions.answer: B) The scooter went missing from the house

questions.question_text: Choose the correct plural form of the noun 'knife'.

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: In 'Papa's Spectacles', where were the spectacles finally found, and how did everyone react? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The spectacles were finally found resting right on top of Papa's head. Everyone laughed heartily at the silly situation and Papa felt quite embarrassed.

questions.question_text: Change the following sentence into the Future Continuous tense: 'The boys play football in the open field.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The correct sentence in the Future Continuous tense is: 'The boys will be playing football in the open field.' This indicates an ongoing action in the future.

questions.question_text: According to the poem 'The Rainbow', what is considered much prettier than boats sailing on rivers and ships sailing on seas? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The poem states that the fluffy clouds that sail across the sky are far prettier than boats on rivers and ships on seas.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the sentence by changing the gender of the nouns: 'The king gave the prince a beautiful horse.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The queen gave the princess a beautiful mare. By changing the masculine nouns to feminine, we create a grammatically correct opposite-gender sentence.

questions.question_text: What clever trick did the parrot use to escape from the cage in 'The Wise Parrot'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The wise parrot pretended to be dead by lying completely still. When the owner opened the cage door in deep sadness, the parrot quickly flew away.

questions.question_text: Explain the humorous sequence of events that took place when the family realized their vehicle was missing in 'Gone with the Scooter'. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: When the family realized the scooter was missing, complete chaos erupted. They ran around asking confused neighbors, searched silly places like cupboards, and eventually found out Uncle had borrowed it without telling anyone, making everyone burst into laughter at the huge misunderstanding.

questions.question_text: Create a short paragraph describing a brave character from 'The Frog'. You must include two proper nouns, two adjectives, and one present continuous verb. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Freddie is a tiny, brave frog who lives in Greenfield Pond. He is currently jumping across the dangerous lily pads to save his friends. His bright green skin shines in the sun as he safely guides them away from the hungry heron.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph about your favorite season. Ensure you use at least two articles (a, an, the) and two different tenses (past and present). [50-60 words]
questions.answer: My favorite season is winter because the weather becomes very cold and pleasant. Last year, I visited a snowy mountain with my family and we built an enormous snowman. I always wear a warm jacket during this time. The hot chocolate we drink makes the freezing evenings truly magical and cozy.

questions.question_text: Write a short informal letter to your cousin thanking them for a birthday gift. Focus on correct sentence structure, capitalization, and punctuation. [50-60 words]
questions.answer:
Dear Ravi,

Thank you so much for the wonderful storybook you sent for my birthday! I started reading it yesterday, and it is absolutely thrilling. The characters are very interesting. I hope we can meet soon so I can tell you all about it. Give my love to Aunt and Uncle.

Yours lovingly,
Amit
